rows.grounds: accusative object of worship in this clause; refers to the received teaching/recitation corpus named in context
contrastive/sequence particle marking the next step after the prior worship
fused verbal form given as one token (prapūjya + atha in sense); marks completion of worship followed by sequence
accusative object of worship; qualified as properly established/place of worship (samyak + āyatana)
injunctive/optative instruction for the rite to be performed

items.question: What sequence of worship is prescribed after the prior northern deities have been honored in this rite?
premises: The received teaching-tradition is named as an object of worship in this step.
Worship of that teaching-tradition is to be completed before the next act.
A properly established shrine is then designated as the next object of worship.
items.inference: One should first complete worship of the āmnāya and then proceed to worship the proper shrine.
uncertainties: Exact scope of āmnāya here (which transmission corpus) is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: Then, after worshipping the teaching-tradition, one should worship the proper shrine.
